title: Months of swarms over Navy ships off Southern California
summary: Marik von Rennenkampf tells of Months of swarms over Navy ships off Southern California, about 2019 at Off Southern California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Channel Islands and Southern California coast

tellings.difference: Puts the swarms at about 100 UAP and says some were pyramid-shaped, without giving a place.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the 2019 UAP swarms that Corbell and Knapp reported. These are the same swarms as the months of incursions over Navy ships off Southern California.

as_told.title: 2019 swarms of about 100 UAP, some pyramid-shaped

plain: A commentator, Marik von Rennenkampf, passing on what journalists Jeremy Corbell and George Knapp have reported, says that in 2019 US Navy ships off the Channel Islands and the Southern California coast faced five or six months of incursions by unexplained objects. Corbell tells it a little differently: he speaks of about 100 UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs, in swarms, and says some were shaped like pyramids, without naming the place. If true, it would mean unknown craft repeatedly moved around Navy warships for months.
